issues.description: Shelf-space utilization reporting appears in multiple places with overlapping obligations (canonical: Shelf-space utilization report; candidate mappings include CAND-00011 and CAND-00156). This creates semantic duplicates and risk of divergent baselines.
issues.suggested_fix: Consolidate into a single canonical shelf-space reporting requirement and map related candidates to it; remove duplicate candidate proposals or unify under one canonical ID.

issues.description: Blacklisted candidate proposals are present in the ledger and could be mistakenly included in final requirements (examples: CAND-00169, CAND-00170, CAND-00171, CAND-00172, CAND-00178).
issues.suggested_fix: Remove blacklisted candidates from the requirements ledger or clearly mark them as out-of-scope so they are not considered in final baselining.

issues.description: Open-template reporting is referenced across multiple candidate entries (for example CAND-00081, CAND-00085, CAND-00119, CAND-00120) with overlapping scope. This may lead to inconsistent capabilities if not reconciled.
issues.suggested_fix: Consolidate open-template reporting into a single, canonical interface and map each candidate to that definition to avoid divergent baselines.

issues.description: Default archival retention values are not consistently defined; while some references show configurable retention (e.g., 7 years), there is no single default policy documented.
issues.suggested_fix: Decide and publish a default data-retention policy (e.g., 7 years for financial/audit data) and mandate its use, with explicit overrides where required by law; ensure all related reports reference this default.

issues.description: Inactive-patrons reporting and outreach exports may include mailing addresses; this raises privacy considerations and requires clear anonymization/isolation rules.
issues.suggested_fix: Audit data exposure in inactive reports; apply data-minimization and anonymization for exports; restrict mailing addresses to authorized outreach use and document handling rules.

issues.description: Data specifications and process descriptions are spread across multiple candidate entries (e.g., CAND-00077, CAND-00078, CAND-00079, CAND-00080, CAND-00206, CAND-00195, CAND-00196, CAND-00197, CAND-00198) with potential drift and divergence.
issues.suggested_fix: Consolidate into a single, authoritative data-model and process-document set; establish version-controlled references and cross-links to ensure consistency across modules.

issues.description: CAND-00208 / missing_detail: The source_context explicitly includes a stakeholder comment that the help system "needs to work with screen readers" (accessibility). The assigned paragraph requires an online, hierarchical, cross-linked, searchable HTML help system and adds organization/searchability details, but it does not include an explicit accessibility/screen-reader requirement present in the source.
issues.suggested_fix: Extend the help-system obligation to explicitly require accessibility for assistive technologies: require the online HTML help system to work with screen readers and other common assistive technologies and document how accessibility is supported and where accessibility-related controls/landmarks are exposed in the UI. (Do not substitute a particular modern standard/version unless stakeholder policy specifies one.)
